_doc: Item catalog. Fields: id, name (singular), category, sub, tags (blade, one-handed, kitchen, gore, magic…), affinity {race: 0..3; missing = rare for that race}, exclusive (only that race), rarity common|uncommon|rare|epic|legendary, value [min,max] silver marks, materials (allowed material ids from materials.json; empty = none), desc, damage (weapons). Built by tools/build-items.py; games extend this file or load their own.
